question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**embracing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about communities and their relationship with sustainable living.
 
• The blank requires a verb that describes how communities adopt or take on sustainable living.
 
• '**Embracing**' means accepting or supporting willingly and enthusiastically.
 
• In this context, communities that willingly adopt sustainable living achieve positive environmental outcomes.
 
• Other options like 'squeeze' (to compress forcefully), 'clutch' (to grasp tightly), and 'enfold' (to surround or envelop) do not fit the context of adopting a way of life.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: Adopting sustainable practices in daily life (1) ***contribute***__ to environmental conservation. Small actions, (2) __***such as***__ reducing single-use plastics, conserving energy, planting trees, using water sparingly and reducing the use of electronic gadgets, (3) ***__collectively __***make a significant impact. Research shows that communities (4) __***embracing ***__sustainable living not only reduce their carbon footprint but also create a healthier environment (5)_______ future generations

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Squeeze**: This implies a physical compression and is not relevant to adopting a lifestyle.
 
• **Clutch**: This means to grasp tightly, often out of fear or desperation, which doesn't fit the positive connotation of adopting sustainable living.
 
• **Enfold**: This means to surround or envelop, which is not the appropriate verb to describe adopting a set of practices.
